title: How the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports could further erode oil inventories
summary: The U.S. blockade of Iranian ports could accelerate the drawdown in global oil inventories, further tightening near-term supply and pushing back hopes of market normalization into mid-May, according to Société Générale.

summary: Medicare doesn’t pay for custodial care. That makes end-of-life decisions even harder for families.

title: The U.S.-Iran war dealt a big blow to the global economy. The IMF tells us how bad it could get.
summary: The U.S. and global economies were poised to accelerate this year before the Iran war. But now, a global watchdog warns of big trouble if a peace deal proves elusive and the conflict gets any worse.
